items.title: Jared Goff: Tops 300 yards in Week 12 loss
items.text:
Goff completed 25 of 36 passes for 313 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 10 rushing yards on three carries.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: Hits paydirt three times against Chicago
items.text:
Gibbs carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns while catching all five of his targets for 47 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
